snippet.title: Bugs & Birdies – Official Trailer | Free Demo October 16 on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5163510/

Bugs & Birdies is a cozy survival sandbox with teeth – alone or in online co-op for up to four players. You wash up on a small island in a wide pixel sea with nothing but the Origin Block. By day the islands are peaceful and full of things to find. By night the beetles come – and that is when you find out how well you built.

Play the free demo from October 16, and join us for Steam Next Fest, October 19–26. The demo already comes with plenty of content and your progress carries over to the full game.

In the trailer:
• Build your farmstead together – fields, fences, furnaces and a whole army of hens
• Explore a world of pixel islands – forests, deserts, jungle, snow and volcanic ash, with weather and tides
• Fish from every shore – and when a storm rolls in, the Kraken takes the bait
• Survive the night – beetle swarms, flame turrets, swords and wands
• Descend into the dungeons – crystal grottos, a labyrinth of core stone, a Lucky Hall with slot machines
• Dynamite rain, the Wheel of Fate and the Beetle King

Online co-op for up to 4 players via Steam. Free updates. Made in Germany by fiftyfive development.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5163510/
Website: https://bugsandbirdies.com

#BugsAndBirdies #SteamNextFest #indiegame #pixelart #coop #survival #sandbox
